programme.desc: 波奈的裙礁是過千種珊瑚,魚類和其他海洋動物的家園,也是許多令人驚嘆的沉船的墓園這些殘骸隨著時日的推移而進化成人工珊瑚,支撐著令人難以置信的多樣性海洋棲息地

programme.title: 狒狒:部落的法則
programme.desc: 跟隨四個不同物種的四個家族-足智多謀的海灘族,好戰的沙漠族,紀律嚴明的河族和愛好和平的山族,找出這些靈長類成為非洲最成功動物之一的原因

programme.title: 地球演化實錄 #1 英普
programme.desc: 走訪地土的盡頭,一個極具生命力的自然劇場正在眼前上演從微小的蝴蝶到巨大的座頭鯨,他們都走在地球演化的最前線,透過不斷改變行為來適應千變萬化的生境,並幫助我們解開對這個藍色星球的種種謎團

programme.title: 地球演化實錄 #2 英普
programme.desc: 散落在不同海洋上的島嶼,其多樣性超乎想像;演化亦在你眼前發生從加拉帕戈斯群島走到南極洲,看看海獅,雀鳥,蟋蟀,猴子和其他野生動物,如何以驚人的適應力來應對氣候變化問題

programme.title: 地球演化實錄 #3 英普
programme.desc: 從撒哈拉到荒野,於極端環境中學習動物如何適應急速變化的氣候並掙扎求存與黑猩猩一起在洞穴中避難,看看駱駝以特別技巧飲用鹽水,並傾聽斑胸草雀為蛋寶寶由唱的歌,了解歌聲如何讓幼雛變得細小

programme.title: 地球演化實錄 #4 英普
programme.desc: 一起走訪迅速融化的極地,看看動物向科學家們留下有關我們未來存留的啟示與線索了解北極熊,企鵝和其他極地生物的動靜如何幫助人類制定應對全球暖化之計

programme.title: 地球演化實錄 #5 英普
programme.desc: 探索地球上非常重要,卻受到忽視的棲息地之一,了解草原在減緩氣候變化上的角色,其吸收碳的容量比森林更大接着拜會野牛和美洲獅等關鍵物種,看看他們如何幫助恢復生態資源,並治癒我們的星球

programme.title: 農場野生物語 #3 英普
programme.desc: 隨著葉子的變化,農場裡的動物露出野性公羊羅傑和哈米殊就像擁有大角般對決,爭奪霸主地位母雞莎莉飛過雞舍,在季末遊覽農場母豬舒娜生下小豬

programme.title: 農場野生物語 #4 英普
programme.desc: 農場裡的動物為一年中最短的日子專心準備為免冬天太沉悶,牛群享受假日美食和演唱會母豬舒娜忙著照料九隻貪玩的小豬,而公羊哈米殊被大眾情人邦妮嫌棄

programme.title: 南荒之地 #1 英普
programme.desc: 新西蘭南島的西南角被巨大的山脈和蠻荒的太平洋所封閉稀有的企鵝每天都被逼與巨型胡氏海獅進行貓捉老鼠的遊戲而海獅也生活在一個動蕩的世界,幼獅必須對抗大自然才能生存下來

programme.title: 南荒之地 #2 英普
programme.desc: 在新西蘭西南部,深邃的峽灣和潮汐形成的潟湖被綠色的雨林覆蓋生活在黑暗峽灣港的生物通常棲息在深海隨著冬季將至,寬吻海豚必須逃離牠們冰冷的峽灣,而在山河中,新西蘭長鰭鰻細聽大海的呼喚

programme.title: 南荒之地 #3 英普
programme.desc: 新西蘭東南岸是世上最富饒的漁場之一,也是海洋動物嬰孩從新丁長大成人之地年輕的鯨魚,海豚和海豹學習捕獵;學習社會規則,甚至開始自己的冒險

programme.title: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​衝過昆士蘭東南地區,在繁殖與捕蛇的季節逐步升溫時,觀看阿黛兒與米克迎戰一條東部棕蛇,這是世界上第二致命的毒蛇,同時史都與麗芙則與一條地毯蟒糾纏搏鬥

programme.title: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​隨著春季的蛇潮展開,跟隨麗芙與史都一起,他們在工地現場攔截兩條為爭奪交配權而決鬥的公棕蛇,這是一場激烈的爭鬥,一場關乎交配資格的爭戰退後站觀,觀看丹與潔絲從一條蟒蛇手中救出雞群,而米克與阿黛兒則追捕一條失控的綠樹蛇

programme.title: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​穿梭於昆士蘭沿海的混亂景象與喧囂之中,傑絲勇敢面對她內心的恐懼,追逐一隻攀爬至樹上的蕾絲蜥蜴,而那棵樹上還棲息著活躍繁忙的蜂巢觀看斯圖小心翼翼地將一條被困在籬笆之間的東方褐蛇救出,並觀察米克為驚慌不安的屋主捕捉那條滑溜難抓,靈活的巨蟒

programme.title: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​潛入狹小緊迫的空間之中,鑽入溫室的底部結構,並進入緊張刺激的救援現場,捕蛇人勇敢面對一條長達六英尺,極度有毒的褐蛇隨後觀看斯圖與莉芙將威脅到屋主寵物安全的沿海巨蟒小心搬遷至安全地點

programme.title: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #5
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​衝進嶄新的郊區社區,馴蛇專家努力阻止致命毒蛇滑入普通家庭住宅觀看斯圖與莉芙將一條東方褐蛇從工地移出,傑絲與丹將巨蟒從倉庫中驅逐出去,而米克與阿黛爾則將紅腹蛇趕出臥室,確保屋主生活區域的安全

programme.title: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #6
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在偏遠農村地產面對危險時,米克與阿黛爾勇敢無畏地應對一條激烈攻擊的褐蛇傑絲與丹小心翼翼地將巨蟒從遊樂區中救出,而當一條捕雞巨蟒在緊張危急的救援過程中壓住莉芙的手時,更令人心跳加速,驚慌不已

programme.title: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在繁殖季節中與米克和阿黛爾一起糾纏不清,他們救了一隻被饑餓的蟒蛇威脅的傑克羅素犬與米克一起在泳池中對抗一條致命的紅腹黑蛇,並與斯圖和莉芙一起在建築工地上處理東部棕蛇

programme.title: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​準備好進行一場火熱的救援,當丹和傑絲從後院移除交配中的東部棕蛇時,然後屏住呼吸,因為米克在沙發墊裡嗅出了一條高度有毒的蛇稍後,觀看斯圖拆解一個雞舍以撬出一條地毯蟒蛇

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #1
programme.desc: 急診室團隊正忙著應對春季患者潮在救援隊抵禦粗魯的袋鼠時,獸醫菲爾 (Phil) 穩定了一隻小袋鼠高級獸醫蒂姆 (Tim) 為一隻被貓抓傷的袋狸治療,並從柵欄捉出一隻魚遊蛇

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #2
programme.desc: 與救援人員喬 (Jo) 一同去撈起一隻吞下魚鉤的鵜鶘,隨後看到山姆 (Sam) 解救了一隻纏在柵欄里的蝙蝠幼崽跟隨獸醫蒂姆,他救助一隻眼睛感染且脾氣怪戾的考拉,並觀看一條笨重的蟒蛇給新手魯比 (Ruby) 帶來的麻煩

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #3
programme.desc: 影子獸醫貝克 (Bec) 為被狗咬傷的考拉瑞秋 (Rachel) 包扎傷口,新手獸醫魯比 (Ruby) 和克里恩 (Kerryn) 負責安撫一群不安分的負鼠與救援人員丹妮 (Dani) 一起解救一對被困在墻上的笑翠鳥,並觀看獸醫蒂姆 (Tim) 為松鼠袋鼯進行的膝蓋手術

programme.title: 進化的奧秘 #3
programme.desc: 動物界中一些最有趣的適應性是無形的研究這些隱藏的內部變化,以觀察不同的動物如何用驚人且看不見的方式進化並生存

programme.title: 動物知心友 #3
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨夏內特,她每天照料岩跳企鵝哈羅德・卡斯塔德,並在巴里斯塔照顧她的好友辛蒂狒狒度過黃金歲月時,感受愛意稍後,在羅科袋熊重返野外時,帶著情感道別

programme.title: 動物知心友 #4
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​為家養驢凱許的生日慶祝,接著與臭鼬米爾頓玩捉迷藏認識海狸比約納,他有一份非常重要的工作,並與樹袋鼠班特利及他的人類媽媽一起探索擁抱與午睡的重要性

programme.title: 超獸 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​沉浸在動物王國中最強大生物的驚人力量之中與銀背大猩猩一起衝破堅硬的白蟻丘,觀察能夠壓碎凱門鱷頭骨的美洲豹,然後前往海洋目睹虎鯨成群獵食的情景

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #6 英普
programme.desc: 對獅子來說,水牛固然是令人滿足的晚餐,但同時也是危險的獵物與穆瓦姆巴獅群一起追蹤為數近三百頭水牛,並從中窺探他們的獵食技巧,他們必須迅速而謹慎地行動

programme.title: 大象傳奇 英普
programme.desc: 大象傳奇有三個故事一頭牛犢穿越奧卡萬戈三角洲一頭公牛正尋覓伴侶一位女族長帶領家人穿過沙漠這些個別的冒險故事一同敍述了非洲最具標誌性物種之一的故事

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​來認識「濱水」獅群的成員吧:雄獅湯姆・湯姆與卡勒,八隻雌獅,十頭年輕的獅子,以及愛因斯坦,那頭從未離開家園,如今已長成的幼獅當愛因斯坦的反叛之舉逐漸發酵,最終在「外來者」獅群的對手發動攻勢時,為他釘下了命運的定局

programme.title: 潮游國度
programme.desc: 退潮時露出一條稱為潮間帶的海岸這是一個令人驚愕的極端之地,受到熱帶氣旋 風浪的衝擊,又暴露在酷熱中這裡的生物以無數怪異的方式進化 科學家們探索這個外星之境

programme.title: 動物知心友 #3

programme.title: 大象傳奇 英普

programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在繁殖季節中與米克和阿黛爾一起糾纏不清,他們救了一隻被饑餓的蟒蛇威脅的傑克羅素犬與米克一起在泳池中對抗一條致命的紅腹黑蛇,並與斯圖和莉芙一起在建築工地上處理東部棕蛇

programme.title: 澳洲蛇類捕捉隊:死亡追捕 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​準備好進行一場火熱的救援,當丹和傑絲從後院移除交配中的東部棕蛇時,然後屏住呼吸,因為米克在沙發墊裡嗅出了一條高度有毒的蛇稍後,觀看斯圖拆解一個雞舍以撬出一條地毯蟒蛇

programme.desc: ​在珊瑚街道中,生存從來不是理所當然,唯有適應,否則就得滅亡​高於常態的溫度使得入秋冷卻變得更加困難,生存難度隨之攀升暫住於小丑魚一家和他們那位海葵房東之間的共生之家,再看看清潔魚如何替魔鬼魟提供一場猶如水中溫泉會館般的療癒服務

programme.desc: 討人喜歡,被視為滑稽的海鸚是冰島的國家象徵,但牠的命運令人擔憂長達十年,海鸚伴侶停止繁殖少數當地熱心人士現已動員起來,力挽狂瀾,拯救這種備受喜愛的海鳥

programme.title: 灰熊的故事:雙孤記
programme.desc: 凱西安達臣撫養一隻名叫砵突士的熊孤兒18年後,將盡一切努力確保沒有熊生活在人造庇護所中有一年,當他得知有兩隻灰熊幼崽成為孤兒後,他的決心受到考驗

programme.title: 巨型長毛象的足跡
programme.desc: 這具百萬年歷史的巨大杜爾福長毛象骨骸,急需進行世界首創的緊急修復我們跟隨這個艱鉅的拆卸和重組脆弱化石的過程透過電腦成像技術(CGI)和博物館知識,這部影片讓這個引人入勝卻鮮為人知的巨型生物重獲生命

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #2
programme.desc: 河流是葡萄牙野生生態的生命線,連接山脈到大海探索成年雄鹿,青蛙的春季儀式和鸊鷉的舞蹈,還有這些生機勃勃的水道沿岸上其他動物和地貌

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #3
programme.desc: 葡萄牙沿海水域和亞速爾群島擁有豐富的生態系統在本集探索生活在這些水域的多元化物種,並發掘牠們獨特的生活

programme.title: 創造之島
programme.desc: 在南太平洋一個偏遠群島的叢林中,一位生物學家正嘗試做著查理斯達爾文和恩斯特邁爾的未竟之事: 在新物種創造過程中捕捉進化的身影懷艾伯特在索羅門群島即將有一個驚人的發現,但一個危機慢慢逼近

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #7
programme.desc: Ben 體驗魯阿佩胡地區正崛起的飲食文化,以及悠久的市集園藝歷史他拜訪了一位第六代農夫,該農夫將一片偏遠荒野打造成繁榮的生態旅遊與高級餐飲目的地,並與一位屢獲殊榮的主廚合作

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #1
programme.desc: 班的美食故事之旅從南方深處開展,他在當地瞭解到為何羊肉如此美味他認識到最早出產松露的先驅,又乘坐直升機在菲奧德蘭國家公園尋找馬鹿

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #2
programme.desc: 班到北地大區旅行並瞭解當地的紅酒他發現一個花生農場,遇到種熱帶木瓜的人,又結識一班以前所未有方式培育紐西蘭黃尾鰤的科學家

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #3
programme.desc: 蘆筍當造 - 班挑選3個品種他遇到一位農民,瞭解到穀飼牛的好處班追隨注重自耕蔬果的土壤姐妹運動

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #4
programme.desc: 班參觀可持續養殖的綠殼青口養殖場,又參觀花生醬工廠他到坎特伯雷見一個鴕鳥農夫,並第一次烹煮鴕鳥!

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #5
programme.desc: 班遇見一位琴酒釀造者和一位義大利肉店商,並讚揚一位致力於永續農產原則的釀酒師班擠羊奶,並瞭解下一代農夫如何打造多元化業務

programme.title: 茱莉亞羅勃茲:美麗標誌
programme.desc: 探索好萊塢最受喜愛的女星 Julia Roberts 的非凡人生從《麻雀變鳳凰》的突破性演出,到奧斯卡獲獎角色,本片呈現她的成長歷程,持久魅力與對影壇的深遠影響,刻畫一位令人難忘的巨星

programme.title: 小勞勃道尼:爬上高峰
programme.desc: 當我們想到好萊塢芸芸眾多藝人時有一個名字脫穎而出從他的辛酸到令人難以置信的果報這就是小勞勃道尼

programme.title: 湯姆克魯斯:開麥啦
programme.desc: 剛登六的湯姆克魯斯仍然是好萊塢頂流之一作為一位多產的演員,他的職業生涯橫跨40年,不斷在電影界創造巨大的遺產

programme.title: 野外的一年:加拿大 #1
programme.desc: 隨著日照越短,天氣越寒冷,加拿大的野生動物正與時間競賽,任何無法好好利用秋天作準備的動物都將滅亡

programme.title: 野外的一年:加拿大 #2
programme.desc: 加拿大的冬天既殘酷又美麗;動物們在冰天雪地裡掙扎求存;不過,雖然有些動物會靜候蓄力,另一些需要撫養孩子的動物則需要迅速適應環境

programme.title: 野外的一年:加拿大 #3
programme.desc: 今年有一個遲來的春天,但當它終於來到,尋覓配偶和組織家庭的競賽就正式開展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的樹蛙,東部的兩萬隻塘鵝,不分地域都想著同一件事

programme.title: 野外的一年:加拿大 #4
programme.desc: 夏季對大部分動物來說都是豐收的季節,但對北極熊卻相反在海洋再度結冰前,牠們無法捕獵海豹,導致日益飢餓對其他動物來說,夏天是幼崽們必須學習如何生存的時機

programme.title: 野外的一年:阿拉斯加 #1
programme.desc: 冬季的結束預示世上最大型又瘋狂的覓食潮來臨,大型海洋獵食者瞄準在阿拉斯加灣尋求庇護的數百萬條魚

programme.title: 野外的一年:阿拉斯加 #2
programme.desc: 隨著春季來臨,日照變長,氣溫上升不過,阿拉斯加只有短暫的春季動物只有兩個月時間來覓食和組織家庭,還要避開獵食者

programme.title: 阿姆斯壯
programme.desc: 《阿姆斯壯》戲劇性,感人且富有洞察力地講述尼爾巖士唐最完整的人生故事-從他在俄亥俄州鄉村的童年到他首次登月-以及伴隨而來非他所願的名人地位

programme.title: 前進宇宙:太空,競賽,火星與更遠之處
programme.desc: 看看太空旅行的發展,以及人類某天踏足火星的潛力

programme.title: 最後衝擊
programme.desc: 科學家史蒂夫託馬斯必須賭上名聲,事業和生命,從一顆直奔地球的巨大小行星中拯救人類

programme.title: 海獵人 #1
programme.desc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧--氣泡網捕食來捕捉大量鯡魚當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中

programme.title: 野外的一年:加拿大 #3
programme.desc: 今年有一個遲來的春天,但當它終於來到,尋覓配偶和組織家庭的競賽就正式開展;西部的黑熊和海狸,南部的樹蛙,東部的兩萬隻塘鵝,不分地域都想著同一件事

programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Birkenhead, Inspector Anthony Joynes is accompanied by the police to attend an unlocked and empty property Inside he finds Teddy, the terrified Terrier cross that has a flea infestation so bad that he's missing half his fur One-year-old Teddy is incredibly nervous, but will he be able to overcome his fears and allow the RSPCA to offer him help?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Because of her love for cats, Claire carefully created a place called "There is a Cat at the Corner" While enjoying your meals and drinks, more than a dozen beautiful cats are strolling freely in the store, waiting to interact with you up close and enjoy a slow life with you However, if you want to pet the cat yourself and win their favor, you must first understand the nature and preferences of cats! Claire also generously shares her “experiences in ruling over dozens of cats”, which is extremely precious Novice cat lovers should come and have a look!

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: Fishes swim in the water What a healing thing it would be to be able to look at the blue ocean every day if we can own an underwater world at home! How can one be the creator of the underwater world? Moreover, in this small ecosystem, most players are male and they even jokingly describe each other as "going underwater"; "Cute Pet Guide" takes you to appreciate the mystery of "going underwater"!

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? programme.title: I Can't Breathe
programme.desc: Police brutality against marginalised communities is not isolated to American shores In 2015, David Dungay Jr, an Aboriginal Australian, died in police custody The coroner later found a “lack of oxygen while he was restrained as a contributing factor to his death”, drawing disturbing parallels with the death of George Floyd in May this year Stan Grant, himself of Aboriginal heritage, feels a kinship across the continents “When I see black America, I see part of myself When I was growing up black America spoke to me when white Australia did not” For those who believe race is no longer an issue that needs discussion, he has a simple message “Why do we still talk about racism? Because it still exists Because it is there Because it can touch my life at any time”

programme.title: Inside Maximum Security
programme.desc: 5 hardened criminals, 1 unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary series, that will show you for the first time what prison is really like Changi Prison is a concret purgatory, spartan to the extreme There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most reclacitrant prisoners So much so that Singapore's reoffending rates are among the lowest globally Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within 2 years after their release For the first time ever, six inmates, incarcerated multiple times, agree to reveal their full udentities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Changi Prison?

programme.desc: For years, allegations of war crimes have swirled around Australia’s special forces in Afghanistan Australian prosecutors have been investigating a small group of elite special forces who stand accused of committing and covering up the murder of civilians in Afghanistan With exclusive footage and testimony from a former special forces operative, this documentary reveals a shocking culture of murder and impunity

programme.desc: The Tigris River, which was the site of the ancient civilization of Mesopotamia, still flows majestically through Baghdad, Iraq's capital In March2003, the area around this river underwent intense airstrikes by US and British forces The US armed forces gained control of Baghdad Journalist Watai Takeharu witnessed the moment when the bronze statue of then-president Saddam Hussein was pulled down The next day he saw many victims of the airstrikes at a city hospital There he met 31-year-old Ali Saqban, whose home had been destroyed in the bombing In his arms he was carrying his 5-year-old daughter Shahad, whose body was covered with blood

programme.title: My Traveling Friends
programme.desc: At 30, Hugo & Paul left France behind For one year, they backpacked to central Asia I met them in Bulgaria—just days to understand why they fled

programme.title: Discover China
programme.desc: During ancient China’s great floods, one man led the nation to safety, took the throne, and divided the land into nine kingdoms

programme.title: Aunty Moves in
programme.desc: Families call on some big-hearted but practical ‘Aunties’ to help them through the rocky terrain of modern life, from money woes to health problems and love life troublesReal people, real problems – there are times when families need nothing short of their own fairy godmother to help them through the rocky terrain of modern lifenFrom money woes to health problems, strife with the teenagers and love life troubles, AUNTY MOVES IN is a series that answers that call for help, in the form of the big-hearted Amiria Reriti and Ata Te Kanawa, real life aunties, who are also fully-qualified – with honours – from the University of Life

programme.title: Serial Swindlers
programme.desc: Exposing the world’s most convincing, creative, and criminally-adept con-men, Serial Swindlers goes inside their minds While their crimes and exploits are a ready-made Hollywood script, their exploits have left a trail of heartache, poverty and destruction

programme.title: Inside Maximum Security
programme.desc: 5 hardened criminals, 1 unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary series, that will show you for the first time what prison is really like Changi Prison is a concret purgatory, spartan to the extreme There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most reclacitrant prisoners So much so that Singapore's reoffending rates are among the lowest globally Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within 2 years after their release For the first time ever, six inmates, incarcerated multiple times, agree to reveal their full udentities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Changi Prison?

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 6 # 10
programme.desc: 丹尼爾和強尼將充滿歷史氣息的巴塞隆納作為隊長們的訓練場但在準決賽中的一次陰險偷襲,引發了一場空前絕後的大混戰

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 6 # 11
programme.desc: 當學生們在規劃告別空手道後的生活時,丹尼爾和強尼因重振世界大會而發生衝突克里斯則重新審視了他的指導原則

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 6 # 12
programme.desc: 珊和羅比在為未來的挑戰進行訓練時,向朋友們尋求支持強尼和卡門迎來了隊伍的新成員

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 6 # 13
programme.desc: 當真相時刻來臨,丹尼爾和強尼勇敢面對過去接著來到了戰鬥時間,羅比將在世界空手道錦標賽中對決阿塞爾

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 6 # 14
programme.desc: 隨著山谷區的頂尖格鬥家們用勇氣對抗對手的速度與力量,戰況愈演愈烈但最後一個驚喜改變了一切

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 6 # 15
programme.desc: 激烈的競爭,全新的機會丹尼爾和強尼發現自己回到了這一切開始的地方--而賭注從未如此巨大

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 # 1
programme.desc: 米格爾命懸一線,羅比失蹤丹尼爾與強尼名譽掃地,社區仍為西谷高中大亂鬥的後續動盪不安

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 # 2
programme.desc: 丹尼爾與強尼放下成見,聯手尋找羅比米格爾的康復之路充滿未知,克里斯試圖召回托莉重返道館

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 # 3
programme.desc: 丹尼爾的事業因形象受損而陷入低潮,並收到收購提議;強尼四處籌錢,為米格爾的手術奔走

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 # 4
programme.desc: 丹尼爾前往日本洽談重要會議,重回沖繩,尋找能讓事業與人生重回正軌的啟示

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 # 5
programme.desc: 在沖繩,丹尼爾重逢舊友與舊敵,意外獲得新的領悟同時,兩大道館的宿怨持續升溫

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 # 6
programme.desc: 米格爾幫助強尼打造完美的社交媒體形象;克里斯積極招募新成員,丹尼爾與阿曼達試圖關閉眼鏡蛇道館

programme.title: 眼鏡蛇道館 3 # 7

programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:饒恕就是釋放 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 中國史上第一個女皇帝武則天為求上位，不擇手段！嘉賓陶傑、游清源大讚她是謀朝篡位的人才！「歷史大誤解」解開江南第一風流才子唐伯虎的風流形象，了解他的真實生活狀況，唐解元還會交代「三笑姻緣」事件。

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 武則天在高宗駕崩之後，有了第一男寵薛懷義，星級導師陶傑、游清源、王晶品評武后在私生活上的風流與角色需要。「大鑊密探凌凌一」發現某些成語故事，竟然存在詐騙成份！蘇軾大爆「卧薪嘗膽」的主角另有其人！

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: Do姐對於農夫介紹何遠東、胡鴻鈞兩位嘉賓出場的笑話，搖頭大表失望，卻見農夫一臉「得戚」？原來在保加利亞，點頭與搖頭有相反意思！台灣「問題專員」欣賞店舖內的藝術畫，又大歎咖啡，究竟店內賣甚麼？泰國的超大型餐廳可容納五千位食客，連菜式亦大有名堂，一道「堅離地冬蔭公」因何得名？日本湯料販賣機供應的樽裝調味湯料，內裡又有甚麼特別？今集竟有嘉賓答題捧蛋收場，幸得Do姐大發慈悲送分，方可參與兌換貨幣遊戲……

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: Do姐請來麥美恩、周奕瑋上演精彩對壘。適當使用酒具能增添飲酒時的樂趣；韓國一款像手榴彈般的新奇產品，有何作用？兩位嘉賓信心十足，同時利用雙倍錦囊先拔頭籌，更得Do姐大讚叻叻！法國里昂大街突兀地出現一格紅色地磚？美國亞利桑那一間洞穴酒店，竟建議住客「朝十晚四」離開房間，如不遵從會發生甚麼事？看過貼士的C君試圖用謊話擾亂敵隊，卻被陸永一眼看穿……今集兌換貨幣環節又刷新紀錄！

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: Bettany繼續她的旅程,走訪烏茲別克、喬治亞、亞塞拜然、希臘、土耳其和保加利亞等地探索偏遠的社區,為觀眾帶來新的考古發掘以及意想不到的故事。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 第三屆星夢公主杯現正舉行中，為體驗現場的演唱會，輝伊芙來到星夢頻道樂園，卻在途中迷路，遇上Ring Marry的吉祥物菈比莉。菈比莉承諾將伊芙帶到賽事現場，可是伊芙卻在好奇心驅使下，闖入施工中的月光魔法區。

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險粵普
programme.desc: 未來的小羊們獲得了灰太狼新制的發明“變小手錶”，變成迷你版小羊並坐上慢羊羊發明的玩具小車，前往微觀世界，幫助大家解決各式各樣的問題。

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險粵普
programme.desc: 未來的小羊們獲得了灰太狼新制的發明“變小手錶”，變成迷你版小羊並坐上慢羊羊發明的玩具小車，前往微觀世界，幫助大家解決各式各樣的問題。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 小夫等人相約去公園玩，只有大雄尚未完成功課，為了騙過媽媽，大雄用「半身外出雲」前往公園。班上玩紙相撲，大雄敗給所有人，多啦A夢借他「機械人紙」製作相撲手，並且替其他人解決不同問題。

programme.title: LET'S CAMP! 露營少女粵日
programme.desc: 凜於凌晨出發，駕電單車去千頭站，與綾乃會合後，兩人決定以畑薙湖為終點，沿途參觀吊橋。撫子一個人出發，轉兩次車後到達千頭站，由於時間關係，她決定跳一班車，用多出來的時間大啖當地美食。

programme.title: 嫁到這世界邊端粵
programme.desc: 丹麥多年來是全球最快樂的國家，Candy嫁到當地卻經常遭當地人歧視及侮辱，唯有對着牛、馬哭訴。一向高高在上的港女，在彼邦卻受盡歧視，Candy憑甚麼支撐下去？丹麥未能給予她一個「家」的感覺，但丈夫、女兒、老爺奶奶，卻確確切切是愛她的家人。老爺曾為了維護Candy，喝罵親生女兒；奶奶在大壽派對上，特意點了中國菜給Candy！說起這些往事，在場人士無不感動，催淚萬分！

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 評判黎諾懿給鼎爺和三姐帶來二百元兩餸一湯考驗！鼎爺使出功夫菜「柑桔柚子雞卷」，將雞卷先蒸後煎夠香口；繼而有清新的「香茅九層塔鹽焗烏頭」，再煮一鍋口感豐富的「雞蓉魚肚粟米羹」，鼎爺在處理雞蓉時有何小技巧？三姐以家常菜式着手，先炮製「番茄薯仔排骨湯」，再用上生薑和沙薑製作「兩薑煎軟雞」。看三姐手起刀落將黃花魚去骨，加上薑蔥及調味即成「家常薑蔥燜黃花魚」。每道菜式都色香味俱全，哪位憑創新、驚喜稍勝一籌？

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 五花腩落在鼎爺與三姐手上，可以玩出甚麼花臣？鼎爺施刀功製作「芋香梅菜寶塔肉」，將五花肉圍邊片薄，要做到連綿不斷，必先要刀工細膩，在選擇五花肉上有何貼士？鼎爺與三姐合拍地將五花肉捲起入模，以薄薄的五花肉片砌成塔狀，非常奪目。三姐採取相對簡約惹味的策略，將五花腩煮熟切成薄片，夾着清爽的青瓜製作「蒜泥白肉」。菜式的精粹在於以陳醋、紅油等調製而成的醬汁，有畫龍點睛的作用。賣相還是惹味更能帶給評判陳煒驚喜？

programme.title: 世紀工程︰機場三跑道系統粵
初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: 蒸烏頭一般多半用豉汁、蒜蓉或欖角，Gigi姐這次向大家介紹一款自創口味，用酸薑、藠頭、酸梅、酸梅醬和青檸這些酸的材料來煮一個醬汁，做成酸梅蒸烏頭，還會分享讓烏頭可以熟得均勻的小秘訣，以及切材料的安全切法。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 都市人每天面對形形色色的生活壓力，經常面對鎂光燈的藝人更不例外。林欣彤(Mag)以「苦澀」形容日常出現的負面情緒，她一方面以唱歌驅走鬱悶感覺，另一方面嘗試走進美食世界，以各種滋味溶化內心苦澀味道。適逢中秋佳節，古嘉俊(阿古)炮製一款別出心裁的「藍莓黃梅慕絲月餅」，為Mag送上佳節祝福。與此同時，Mag還在製作甜品過程中尋獲開懷秘方。

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 御富良院和阿渡誤墮急流，幸被瑪蘿救起，此時他們遇到奇里和努奇兄弟，對方展示出一系列精華片段，反映御富良院行為卑劣，更是炎上達的手下，御富良院百辭莫辯，連阿渡和瑪蘿都開始流露懷疑。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: Edelweiss是一種小白花，象徵勇敢；十三位小朋友勇敢地踏上「My Little Show」的舞台，頌唱這首經典英文歌。有歌者還提到演出時會幻想陽光照亮小白花的情境，感到溫暖和舒服。另有兩位年紀輕輕的舞者，獻上倫巴舞表演，熱情浪漫之餘，舞姿也不失優美。生活總是會遇到不少困難，Sherman姐姐聯同結他導師和嘉賓羅皓誼Chloe姐姐，以歌聲唱出<小手拉大手和<一雙手，帶出互相扶持的力量。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 改編自人氣繪本。各位小朋友快跟著無人不知的名偵探屁屁偵探全面出擊，透過細心觀察及推理，偵破各類案件吧！

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小杉垂涎人家花園種植的西瓜。第二天小丸子看到那些西瓜少了一個，因此懷疑是小杉偷了。小丸子見到姐姐出門前悉心打扮，因此很好奇姐姐去哪裡。但姐姐不願透露，小丸子於是偷偷地跟蹤姐姐。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 傳統酒樓市場越來越萎縮，有老牌酒樓集團，多年來都靠建立不同餐飲品牌，以爭取市場。按計劃最遲2035年，政府會停止燃油小巴新登記，小巴營運商購買電動小巴的意欲如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 他們生於1981年至1996年之間，人稱Y世代，一般成長於傳統的管教方式。如今成為父母，面對的壓力不比上一代少，社會對育兒的期望亦由「盡責」到「最好」，加上比較文化，令教養變成無形的競賽。想溫柔教養，卻忍不住勞氣。責罵之後，又會內疚自責。今集走訪幾位Y世代家長的故事，了解他們如何在壓力夾縫中，為自己及下一代尋找出路。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 女事主奉獻廿年青春與積蓄，卻換來無良丈夫！夫婦聯名置業，要於樓契加上奶奶名字？女事主控訴丈夫無所事事，靠她養活家庭與供樓，但當她失業後，男方態度大變。女事主心碎提出離婚，始知物業是「長命契」，丈夫更索要贍養費……攝製隊聯絡涉事奶奶，對方卻有不同說法？周星馳自編自導的新戲在香港舉行首映禮，他率領眾演員謝票；張繼聰、蔡思貝笑言不敢找偶像星爺合影。上集「中4」由周志康奪MVP，新一輪則迎「改編歌之夜」。

programme.title: 天喜堂天喜丸120 週年呈獻：中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: 香港樂壇於早年曾盛行將外語歌曲，改編為廣東歌，並誕生不少耳熟能詳的經典作品。累積排名戰來到關鍵的第四回合，總成績暫列下游的十強參賽者尤其要拼盡搶分，而選手們會以改編歌作為比賽曲目。節目組請得當年以「新秀」冠軍身分出道的譚耀文，擔任本集「客席評審」及MVP評選人。兩位出色DJ梁繼璋、范振鋒則列席「知音人」，除此之外，歐瑞強、潘偉源、歐丁玉、陳少寶等著名音樂人亦受訪，分享關於改編歌的點滴或幕後故事。

programme.title: 專業旅運40週年呈獻：香港小姐湘遇記粵
programme.desc: 這集，三組各自挑戰一項任務，組內勝出者將獲得十秒拉票時間。師姐黃嘉雯的隊伍要於水上漂流，有人於水上迷失方向，有人因為海草而呼叫，最終有2位佳麗同時衝線！馮盈盈帶領的四人先於五分鐘內學習湘繡技巧，再限時三十分鐘刺繡香港小姐官方標誌，盈盈竟私下想幫某位零刺繡經驗的師妹？考驗陳懿德組別的任務，是於古鎮景區內「吊威也」以完成「天女散花」的動作，對畏高者確是大考驗。4位佳麗隨後都能敢於嘗試，並展現仙氣一面。

programme.title: 一周星星粵
programme.desc: 熱播劇《夫妻的博弈》，故事從高海寧所發的「預知夢」展開。她的演戲路則由《讀心神探》中被殺而開始，現時回看有何評價？《夫》劇裡，馬國明是「暖男天花板」，現實中的他卻自認「媽寶」！傳聞指馬明將薪金上繳及全家會為玩偶「慶生」，他統統承認，令旁邊拍檔控訴他提升了標準，包括將結婚的何廣沛。若可抹走一段黑歷史，會選哪一段？郭柏妍未入行前自揭感情狀態「A0」，可感後悔？重溫鄧智堅在節目扮女人，他直言享受演出！

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
世紀工程︰機場三跑道系統粵
廉政狙擊#21粵PG
programme.desc: 屠敏向繼明表露身分，並告知當年塌樓乃是廷光的奸計，繼明便加入屠敏團隊展開報復。繼明主動與以凡修補關係，並要求加入廷暉集團；廷光並不完全信任繼明，便指派他進行危險任務。任務中繼明遇上子峰，兩人四目交投…

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 女事主奉獻廿年青春與積蓄，卻換來無良丈夫！夫婦聯名置業，要於樓契加上奶奶名字？女事主控訴丈夫無所事事，靠她養活家庭與供樓，但當她失業後，男方態度大變。女事主心碎提出離婚，始知物業是「長命契」，丈夫更索要贍養費……攝製隊聯絡涉事奶奶，對方卻有不同說法？周星馳自編自導的新戲在香港舉行首映禮，他率領眾演員謝票；張繼聰、蔡思貝笑言不敢找偶像星爺合影。上集「中4」由周志康奪MVP，新一輪則迎「改編歌之夜」。

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: Gi味俱全粵
programme.desc: 蒸烏頭一般多半用豉汁、蒜蓉或欖角，Gigi姐這次向大家介紹一款自創口味，用酸薑、藠頭、酸梅、酸梅醬和青檸這些酸的材料來煮一個醬汁，做成酸梅蒸烏頭，還會分享讓烏頭可以熟得均勻的小秘訣，以及切材料的安全切法。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 都市人每天面對形形色色的生活壓力，經常面對鎂光燈的藝人更不例外。林欣彤(Mag)以「苦澀」形容日常出現的負面情緒，她一方面以唱歌驅走鬱悶感覺，另一方面嘗試走進美食世界，以各種滋味溶化內心苦澀味道。適逢中秋佳節，古嘉俊(阿古)炮製一款別出心裁的「藍莓黃梅慕絲月餅」，為Mag送上佳節祝福。與此同時，Mag還在製作甜品過程中尋獲開懷秘方。

programme.title: 嫁到這世界邊端粵
programme.desc: 丹麥多年來是全球最快樂的國家，Candy嫁到當地卻經常遭當地人歧視及侮辱，唯有對着牛、馬哭訴。一向高高在上的港女，在彼邦卻受盡歧視，Candy憑甚麼支撐下去？丹麥未能給予她一個「家」的感覺，但丈夫、女兒、老爺奶奶，卻確確切切是愛她的家人。老爺曾為了維護Candy，喝罵親生女兒；奶奶在大壽派對上，特意點了中國菜給Candy！說起這些往事，在場人士無不感動，催淚萬分！

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 評判黎諾懿給鼎爺和三姐帶來二百元兩餸一湯考驗！鼎爺使出功夫菜「柑桔柚子雞卷」，將雞卷先蒸後煎夠香口；繼而有清新的「香茅九層塔鹽焗烏頭」，再煮一鍋口感豐富的「雞蓉魚肚粟米羹」，鼎爺在處理雞蓉時有何小技巧？三姐以家常菜式着手，先炮製「番茄薯仔排骨湯」，再用上生薑和沙薑製作「兩薑煎軟雞」。看三姐手起刀落將黃花魚去骨，加上薑蔥及調味即成「家常薑蔥燜黃花魚」。每道菜式都色香味俱全，哪位憑創新、驚喜稍勝一籌？

programme.title: 教煮爭霸粵
programme.desc: 五花腩落在鼎爺與三姐手上，可以玩出甚麼花臣？鼎爺施刀功製作「芋香梅菜寶塔肉」，將五花肉圍邊片薄，要做到連綿不斷，必先要刀工細膩，在選擇五花肉上有何貼士？鼎爺與三姐合拍地將五花肉捲起入模，以薄薄的五花肉片砌成塔狀，非常奪目。三姐採取相對簡約惹味的策略，將五花腩煮熟切成薄片，夾着清爽的青瓜製作「蒜泥白肉」。菜式的精粹在於以陳醋、紅油等調製而成的醬汁，有畫龍點睛的作用。賣相還是惹味更能帶給評判陳煒驚喜？

programme.title: 文明啟航粵英
programme.desc: Bettany繼續她的旅程,走訪烏茲別克、喬治亞、亞塞拜然、希臘、土耳其和保加利亞等地探索偏遠的社區,為觀眾帶來新的考古發掘以及意想不到的故事。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#159粵
programme.desc: 家人突支持悅投考輔警，將家中變成臨時學堂。根建議朋用「愛」淡化悅投考的決心。朋竟扮精神錯亂，又哭又笑吸引家人注意，被悅拆穿。朋繼續假作發生交通意外，弄至行動不便，但悅卻說出決不會放棄，結果悅成功考上。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#4粵普PG
programme.desc: 被追殺的郭靖和黃蓉情急之下跳下枯井，竟遇見梅超風，黃蓉用黃藥師的名頭哄騙梅超風保護他們。完顏康得知其生父是楊鐵心，無法接受現實。完顏洪烈調動士兵包圍眾人，楊鐵心不忍連累別人選擇自殺，包惜弱也隨他而去。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 樓盤新視野 之港島東太古式生活粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 一個人煮未必一定要吃「飯」，肥媽示範「番茄肥牛烏冬」，味道經已非同凡響。肥媽教你用少於坊間一半的價錢製作「日式雜菌湯通粉」。還嫌太貴？肥媽出動殺手鐧，示範如何用八元炮製一人份量的「蝦仁泡飯」！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 長期忽視缺牙情況，易引致鄰牙傾倒及齒槽骨萎縮，不少患者因而選擇植牙。隨着近年植牙手術邁向數碼化，透過數位印模、3D導航技術，能顯著提升精準度，並減少術後不適，且聽牙醫介紹植牙新知。藝人莫文蔚的媽媽莫何敏儀亮相節目，分享育兒心得，建議家長多助孩子發掘潛能。她還欣慰表示兒子當年憑獎學金考入劍橋大學，也揭女兒自小就愛表演。莫媽媽又呼籲長者放開懷抱，保持快樂心境。「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「腰果紅咖喱魚」。

programme.title: 玩轉深中懶人包粵
programme.desc: 江門新會是「陳皮之鄉」，團隊先到陳皮村品嚐傳統三寶扎茶，見識大片柑田，再往百年老字號試飲陳皮咖啡、酸奶等新飲品。陳皮入饌既滋味又養生，蒸鰻魚、藥膳雞等滲出陳皮幽香。古井燒鵝亦是地道名菜，鵝油撈麵、柑果糯米飯又有何驚喜？「世遺」開平碉樓、三十三墟老街都散發濃厚歷史氣息，眾男為做主角，竟爭吃「人氣」豬腳麵？置身新舊交融的度假酒店，兩隊瘋狂玩水戰。遊台山必吃黃鱔飯，脆皮叉燒更令家燕姐重演經典食評一幕！

programme.title: 東坡家事#20粵PG
programme.desc: 皇上要立琴操為妃，着她靜候佳音。農民丁東懷「流民圖」被奸官捉拿；安石發現畫作偽造。黎田指有乾女盼皇上立為妃，安石指乾女即琴操且身分有嫌疑。丁東乘有人劫獄逃走；東坡帶洪四和丁東之女丁丁從地道偷入皇宮……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 情人節將至，姐姐打算自製巧克力送給秀樹，但看見小渚為花輪特別炮製的巧克力後，決定投放更多心思重新製作。小杉因身型肥大，玩擠饅頭遊戲特別受歡迎，豬太郎感到羨慕，於是想盡辦法增肥自己。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 森林盆景大多會將植物配以砂土，巧妙地搭建出充滿生命力的微型世界，猶如私人小花園。相關公司創辦人在「Kids’ Notes」分享如何運用易於打理的真植物來做設計，植物照顧起來頗為簡單，孩子也能輕鬆勝任，更可助他們建立成就感。小朋友如想跟爸媽一起動手製作森林盆景，嘉賓建議可用牛奶樽或飲品膠樽作為盆景器皿，並細談挑選植物心得，以及失敗經驗。另外，這集亦會播放AI生成動畫《拔苗助長》。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 靜香養大的小鳥啟發大雄，令他想親手孵蛋養寵物。多啦A夢給了他一顆蛋，結果孵出了小颱風風子。大雄因不懂騎單車被丟下，多啦A夢借他「萬能輔助石」，讓三輪車得到強力輔助而變得速度飛快。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.desc: 樓市交投放緩，但對樓價影響不大，天水圍有兩房呎價，重上10,000元水平，升勢能否延續？

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#6粵PG
programme.desc: 幸如率領「女子組」負責首個項目，給云瓏飲食集團的品牌重塑；原來這是上司伍其昌暗地部署的一切，認為熙妍能力有限，婉蘭、阮思穎常因私務分心。雪文欲乘虛而入，但繼威無意與幸如分手。幸如靠夢中經驗推銷新意念，未料遭云瓏的代表否決，眾女面臨危機。其昌安排另一組的繼威、何子偉接手項目。幸如利用雪文逆轉，危機解決，幸如的新廣告設計更得到云瓏賞識，原來家謙私下出手幫助。家謙珍藏着一瓶巧克力，原來他與幸如早有緣分。

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：重症解密粵
programme.desc: 改編案例的患者於39歲確診乳癌第二期，懷疑因自幼愛吃雞翼而受激素影響有關。外科教授鄺靄慧卻指出，患者未曾生育及哺乳，加上高脂飲食，以及服用避孕藥影響經期，都可能是潛在的致病因素。患者曾將乳癌硬塊誤會是經期結節，教授細說如何分辨。乳癌亦可能由基因突變引起，即使父母沒有乳癌病史，也存在相關風險？「調查員」陳曉華隨教授了解不需切除乳房的冷凍治療新技術，以及即時自體脂肪移植技術，都有助乳癌病人重拾自信。

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#11粵普

再創世紀#19粵
programme.desc: 啟堂為盡快康復提出到瑞士休養。高哲提議投資大嶼山再生能源，定垚婉拒。有越南水力發電公司來港上市，欲借傲堂炒作話題，定垚差點上當，幸得高哲解圍。高哲再提出大嶼山項目，定垚被打動。敬賢調查克網來歷，無功而回。程凱與澤雨對智能家居充滿憧憬，提出追加投資金額，松蔭希望盡快推出產品。學禮成為大嶼山風力發電項目顧問，天生與定垚為此展開爭奪戰！金水村居民向天生查問收地事件，海泉斥責明晞回家只為向村民收地。

programme.title: 玩轉深中懶人包粵
programme.desc: 江門新會是「陳皮之鄉」，團隊先到陳皮村品嚐傳統三寶扎茶，見識大片柑田，再往百年老字號試飲陳皮咖啡、酸奶等新飲品。陳皮入饌既滋味又養生，蒸鰻魚、藥膳雞等滲出陳皮幽香。古井燒鵝亦是地道名菜，鵝油撈麵、柑果糯米飯又有何驚喜？「世遺」開平碉樓、三十三墟老街都散發濃厚歷史氣息，眾男為做主角，竟爭吃「人氣」豬腳麵？置身新舊交融的度假酒店，兩隊瘋狂玩水戰。遊台山必吃黃鱔飯，脆皮叉燒更令家燕姐重演經典食評一幕！

programme.title: 東坡家事#21粵PG
programme.desc: 安石外遊時與老伯下棋後生病，李大夫發現其脈象奇異。皇上派少游和兩太醫往蠶村了解疫情；小妹找洪四相伴往蠶村。少游明白這病易傳染，隔離病人；小妹被女病人弄傷手指……李大夫目露凶光向眾人襲擊後吐白泡死去……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#159粵
programme.desc: 家人突支持悅投考輔警，將家中變成臨時學堂。根建議朋用「愛」淡化悅投考的決心。朋竟扮精神錯亂，又哭又笑吸引家人注意，被悅拆穿。朋繼續假作發生交通意外，弄至行動不便，但悅卻說出決不會放棄，結果悅成功考上。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#4粵普PG
programme.desc: 被追殺的郭靖和黃蓉情急之下跳下枯井，竟遇見梅超風，黃蓉用黃藥師的名頭哄騙梅超風保護他們。完顏康得知其生父是楊鐵心，無法接受現實。完顏洪烈調動士兵包圍眾人，楊鐵心不忍連累別人選擇自殺，包惜弱也隨他而去。

programme.desc: 安葬了楊鐵心夫妻後，丘處機與江南六怪讓郭靖娶穆念慈，郭靖不肯，被追問出心上人就是黃蓉時，六怪逼郭靖發誓不再與黃蓉來往，黃蓉突然出現，並趁亂拉著郭靖離開。穆念慈收留了落魄的楊康，楊康被穆念慈的氣節折服。

programme.desc: 豬雜粥配豬潤腸粉，以江門早餐迎接新一天！五邑菜結合五地精髓，從山螃蜞、黃沙蜆、馬崗鵝、杜阮涼瓜等細嚐地道風味。舊廠房變身文創熱點，星級茶餐廳老闆古明華為家燕姐調製奶茶，奉上港式美食，份外親切！換上民初服飾後乘船遊赤坎古鎮，感受中西合璧的古樸風韻；眾人還認識復古電訊設備，體驗傳統陶藝、玉石花手藝。私房菜餐廳自設荷塘，巧製荷葉水鴨湯、蒸釀蓮藕夾、冰鎮鮮蓮子等時令荷香美饌。另一探城央綠廊夜市的熱鬧氛圍。

programme.desc: 前田同學衣服上的紐扣不見了，但遍尋不獲，藤木發現紐扣掉進了自己的手提袋，卻不敢說出來。小丸子擦走家中白板上自己的留言，卻不慎把媽媽的留言擦去部分，唯有循剩下的「大」字作出種種聯想。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 芭菲精靈留守零食廠考核小朋友，但簡單一個附帶「廠長話」的指令，竟揭露大家不懂得芭菲精靈是誰？某隊兩位成員同時齊心放下手，結果就此錯失了一卷健康零食秘笈！不過，該隊伍並無灰心和氣餒，在「魔法地壺」遊戲中成功收集四款食材，吐氣揚眉。運送雪糕球任務，四位小兵都穩穩陣陣，快速將雪糕球運送到終點。哪一方能取得最後一卷健康零食秘笈，視乎雪糕球總數來定斷。另外，「AI小學堂」會探討如何利用運算思維向AI提問。

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日
programme.desc: 柚子公主又偷走出城堡外，柚子爺爺發覺之後慌忙尋找。另一方面，細菌人按紅精靈的要求，想把柚子公主抓回去。細菌人製造了科學怪機，因此科學怪機認定細菌人是爸爸，並且很想與他見面。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 目前香港長者北上就醫可使用醫療券，於大灣區指定服務點支付門診費用。另外，部分香港商業保險亦已開通跨境「保險直付」服務，讓患者在指定三甲醫院就診時免去墊付流程。內地公立醫院與私家診所價格和質素參差，加上醫療券、直付及內地醫保等多種支付方式並存，如何釐清各種方案的適用範圍與限制？

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#2粵
programme.desc: 嘉冰與萬里、唐芯同住，擾亂萬里的生活。萬里致電父親欲探知嘉冰回港的真正目的，卻無功而回。嘉冰則向弟弟曹嘉驄透露秘密，並表明打算留港長住。萬里追問嘉冰歸期，嘉驄謊稱她不久便會回去，萬里卻想令嘉冰知難而退。另一方面，唐芯欲查明嘉冰與萬里甚少往來、似有嫌隙的原因，卻不得要領。她告知嘉驄自己已獲批大學宿位，有望擺脫萬里的控制，並想到能順利入住宿舍的方法，而嘉冰正是關鍵人物。唐芯為此付出不少努力，詎料……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#7粵PG
programme.desc: 啟榮知道家謙暗助幸如而發脾氣，原來他患有情緒病。祖母葉卓苓君讚賞家謙，啟榮暗中不滿。幸如差點被車撞，家謙及時相救，幸如閃過之前遭車撞的零碎片段。浩恩對幸如未忘情；家謙得知浩恩是幸如初戀，與他暗地較勁。幸如得悉家謙知道自己做了預知夢，家謙坦言不信但願意幫忙。幸如得知雪文買了催情藥，欲借助家謙推雪文與繼威一把，不料雪文打算將藥用在幸如和浩恩身上。幸如及時發現雪文詭計，腦筋急轉反擊，卻意外掉到水中。

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：重症解密粵
programme.desc: 主動脈負責將心臟泵出的血液供給全身各個維生器官，極為重要，一旦撕裂，每小時會增加約1%死亡率！有何高危因素？心胸外科教授指，此症還要視乎是升主動脈還是降主動脈出狀況，前者要急切施行開胸手術，期間需停止心臟，並以體外循環機輔助。高血壓是主動脈撕裂的風險因素之一，而高血壓人士或患有胸腔主動脈瘤，一部小小的手提超聲波即可初步探測？教授形容主動脈撕裂像計時炸彈，建議於爆炸前就「拆彈」，如何從生活習慣預防？

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#12粵普
programme.desc: 中菜廳被迫停業，紀封打算趁機整頓餐飲部，還得到董事會同意重新裝修中菜廳；但是翱翔搶走了裝修公司，紀封決定向嘉銘請教；記者拍攝菲菲的日常，豈料被冰燕搶走了鏡頭；馬科斯的代理跟紀封簽約，誤以為貞貞是蜜語…

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
再創世紀#20粵
programme.desc: 金水村非原居民代表袁康年不想賣地，定垚查得康年的秘密，康年答應不再帶頭鬧事。依寧給敬賢帶來天生的負面資料，敬賢為求真精神專訪天生。天生被詹兆齊出賣令競選商會主席失敗，懷恨在心。程凱為智能家居20連夜趕工，因睡過頭趕不及董事會，澤雨只好拿出尚未完善的10來彙報，程凱大發雷霆。天生游說海泉賣地，海泉竟破口大罵，天生忍無可忍直斥海泉無能，從未給予妻女幸福。海泉突然支持賣地，同時有雜誌揭破康年的秘密…

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 交感神經負責調節不需意識控制的生理功能，當人體長期處於交感神經「過度興奮」狀態，會對心血管系統造成多重不良影響。心臟科醫生詳析相關資訊，並提醒恆常監察血壓及心率的重要性。模特兒出身的藝人蔣怡下廚了得，育有一對子女，她會到來暢談近況。為何當年於女兒剛出世時，決定往倫敦進修廚藝？愛吃的她怎樣保持纖瘦身型？除了烹飪等興趣外，蔣怡亦分享育兒、平衡家庭與工作的心得。「睇餸食飯」，三姐示範「瑤柱蟹肉扒節瓜」。

programme.title: 玩轉深中懶人包粵PG
programme.desc: 豬雜粥配豬潤腸粉，以江門早餐迎接新一天！五邑菜結合五地精髓，從山螃蜞、黃沙蜆、馬崗鵝、杜阮涼瓜等細嚐地道風味。舊廠房變身文創熱點，星級茶餐廳老闆古明華為家燕姐調製奶茶，奉上港式美食，份外親切！換上民初服飾後乘船遊赤坎古鎮，感受中西合璧的古樸風韻；眾人還認識復古電訊設備，體驗傳統陶藝、玉石花手藝。私房菜餐廳自設荷塘，巧製荷葉水鴨湯、蒸釀蓮藕夾、冰鎮鮮蓮子等時令荷香美饌。另一探城央綠廊夜市的熱鬧氛圍。

programme.title: 東坡家事#22粵PG
programme.desc: 小妹受傳染，狂性大發襲擊少游；病人欲逃出驛站，少游被他們抓傷。萬里帶官兵準備燒村……淑眉將藏有小妹名字的草娃交予梁氏；梁氏在街上遇高興和高貴，他們指小妹有孕，淑眉要母親加速害小妹流產。事件東窗事發……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#160粵
programme.desc: 朋拼命地督促婷準備會考，令她苦不堪堪言。朋繼續迫婷溫習，根認為朋過分擔心，更吹噓自己若應考，成績絕對名列前茅。最後眾人將婷及根反鎖在家中，並在花的嚴厲教導下，強迫二人進行「地獄式補習」。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#5粵普PG
programme.desc: 安葬了楊鐵心夫妻後，丘處機與江南六怪讓郭靖娶穆念慈，郭靖不肯，被追問出心上人就是黃蓉時，六怪逼郭靖發誓不再與黃蓉來往，黃蓉突然出現，並趁亂拉著郭靖離開。穆念慈收留了落魄的楊康，楊康被穆念慈的氣節折服。

programme.title: 我是小廚神-新加坡篇粵普
programme.desc: 12位候選小廚神分成3組進行初賽，爭奪8個入圍名額。今集主題是自選菜式，有人煮出媽媽的愛心，亦有人擺出精緻的法國主菜，其餘小朋友做出日本、印度、蒙古、斯里蘭卡、新加坡等各國的味道，評判之一的陳煒對這些異國風情有何評價？有參賽者滿有信心，卻未能守住廚師基本守則；亦有人不理會主持勸喻，不斷下醬油，能否換來驚喜味道？評判還有香港的烹調家麥潔兒及新加坡的糕點導師范鈺渟，要完全滿足三人的口味委實不易！

programme.title: CI ALK 國際直球對決(重)
CI ALK 國際直球對決(重)

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 監獄醫生

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Musical Statues

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Puppets
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners so he can ask Mum on a date, but things go awry when Unicorse eats a tick.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Wisdom Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels see Duggee reading Wonderful Stories about Wise Animals and want to learn about wisdom and how they can become more wise. They find out that wisdom isn't just about facts and figures, but that it's about good judgement and experiences too. They learn to plan ahead, concentrate on the task at hand, that sometimes big problems need a little help, to focus on the present and that good things come to those who wait. Thank goodness Duggee is so wise!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Listening Badge
programme.desc: After hearing a strange sound, the Squirrels turn to Duggee to help identify its source. They learn about sound waves, and that you can listen for different qualities in the sounds, such as if it's loud, quiet, high or low. Describing the sound can help you work out where it's coming from, so Duggee lets the Squirrels close their eyes as they listen to sounds and make their guesses.

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: The Long Chase
programme.desc: Governor Yan is killed and his guard Fan identifies Kou as the assassin by his signature weapon, a dart. Kou is listed as a wanted man when he enters the city, but managed to escape arrest with the help of the innkeeper's daughter. At the same time, Fan is attacked by a bandit who pretends to be Kou. What are the secret plots behind these attacks?

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tien's gang is helping them; he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: The King Boxer
programme.desc: Promising martial artist Chao Chih Hao leaves home to compete in a prestigious tournament after training under a legendary master. However, when a corrupt rival school hires Japanese fighters to cripple him, Chao endures brutal training to master the deadly “Iron Fist” technique and return for a fierce, bone-crushing battle for justice and glory.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh's looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet "Classic Beauty".

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: After avenging his father's death by assassinating a high official, Li Yue disappears into hiding as a fugitive. His fiancée enlists a swordsman—who secretly loves her—to search for him, unaware that the bandit Xiao Mei has also fallen for Li Yue. Their intertwined love quadrangle explores themes of sacrifice, devotion and selfless love.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General's henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yen's family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: As more people are learning martial arts from Shaolin, the Qing court orders for it to be banned and plans to destroy the temple. The Shaolin disciples decide to take their protest to the streets, using Shaolin skills to curb their hatred, but when the Qing troops start attacking Shaolin Temple, the disciples vow to protect it at all costs.

programme.title: Apartment for Ladies
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies' youthful vitality within the apartment.

programme.title: Invincible Enforcer
programme.desc: A young man is at the wrong place at the wrong time. As he offends a police inspector, he is thrown into jail and even when released, the police goes after him until he has no choice but to become a real criminal. Only a kind and beautiful probation officer is on his side, but can she help him?

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: A young guy Wu, heads off to the Dragon Valley to meet his childhood friend Lian Chu, who was promised to be his bride. When he arrives, he finds out that the family of his bride may not be an entirely honest bunch of people. Wu wishes to take Lian Chu with him, so he has no choice but to fight against her family…

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father…

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the “speed gang”, led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the “speed gang” while on the island – can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to attend school and falls in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After discovering her true identity, Shan Bo proposes marriage, only to learn that Ying Tai has been promised to another man. Forced apart, Shan Bo dies in despair. Devastated by the news, Ying Tai kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: When Jianying discovers the Zhao clan's fortune will be left to his brother Yulong, he engineers his parents' death and sends his own son out to kill Yulong.

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: There's no place like home.

programme.title: Heroes Two
programme.desc: Shaolin disciple Hong escapes from the burning temple after a Qing army attack, but suffers serious injuries while fleeing. Mistaking Hong for a dangerous outlaw, Fang captures him and hands him over to the Qing soldiers. After learning the truth, Fang does everything he can to rescue Hong, so the two can join forces against the Qing army.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case…

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son's arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son's arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: Yu Fang Fang survives the massacre of her master's family at the hands of the Crimson Charm gang but loses her arm in the process. Determined, she vows to team up with a swordsman seeking revenge against the ruthless gang.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family's daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family's background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancée, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires the skills from “Nine Yang Scriptures” by chance, he is also embroiled in this lengthy battle.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: Demon of the Lute
programme.desc: Lute demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng Ling is ordered to help find a special bow and arrows that can counter the demon. Only Chiao Yin knows the whereabouts of the weapon. Hsiao and her classmate Old Naughty set out on an arduous journey to find Chiao. After overcoming many obstacles, they catch Chin Mo's man trying to snatch the bow and manage to stop him in time....

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: The Black Butterfly
programme.desc: Kwan leads a double life as a waitress and as an infamous outlaw skilled in martial arts, The Black Butterfly. When she steals a cache of gold from the Five Devils Rock bandits, she soon has the bandits, and the government, on her tail.

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: In a time of anti-Manchu sentiment, Emperor Yong Zheng employs his ruthless Blood Hound Corps to silence any dissenters. Only one man and his signature weapon, The Flying Guillotine, stand in their way.

programme.title: Summer Heat
programme.desc: Aptly described by its original title of "Money, Sex And Love", this is a gripping drama about Judy, a woman with a rich husband as well as two lovers who happen to be brothers. Jenny Hu is Judy, and her knockout beauty makes this summer sizzle...

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih get his restaurant back at all costs when it was forcefully taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei’s possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lian’s affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai…

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch—but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrant's plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own "Drunken Fist" style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Jailed for accidental manslaughter, martial arts master Har Hao Mo discovers a killer targeting kung fu masters across Hong Kong. Determined to stop the murders, he helps police track down Fung Yu Sau, a ruthless fighter obsessed with proving his supremacy. As the killings continue, the two martial artists are drawn toward a deadly showdown.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua’s hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Yan is a police mole in the triad and joined them before he graduated from the police academy, while Ming is a triad mole in the police since young. Leading parallel lives, both men feel increasingly trapped in their false surroundings, and a series of cat-and-mouse chases ensue as both the triad and the police compete to uncover the other’s mole.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation…

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair…

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair…

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong’s Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family’s massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: The World Today
programme.desc: The core rolling news service of CGTN, with regular updates from Beijing, Washington, Nairobi and London, keep viewers up-to-date with all the world’s top stories as they happen. The World Today delivers breaking news, live events, in-depth reporting, expert analysis and sustained coverage.

programme.title: Razor
programme.desc: CGTN's brand new science and technology show, covering cutting edge developments from all over the world. RAZOR will show you the world's most powerful laser and the world's smallest anti-cancer treatment. It will take you from the weird world of quantum computing to the boundaries of the cosmos. An international team of reporters will follow the guidance of Occam's Razor - the principle that the simplest explanation is the best one. RAZOR will show that we are already ""living in the future"!

Jio catches his girlfriend cheating and wants to end his life, but Citra, who sees Jio trying to commit suicide, calms him down. Citra eventually teams up with Jio for an exclusive story. Will sparks of romance fly between Jio and Citra?

programme.title: Hati Abang Satpol PP Dibadutin Jangan
programme.desc: Regina (Indah Nicole) works as a clown. She does this job because it’s the only skill she has, and it’s easy to do without requiring a college degree. One day, while Regina was performing in the city’s bustling streets, a group of Satpol PP officers arrived to conduct a street enforcement raid. Regina panicked when she was chased by a handsome Satpol PP officer (Eza Gionino). She ran as fast as she could.

programme.title: SESAMA COPET DILARANG SALING MENCURI HATI - EP5
programme.desc: A beautiful girl named Dinda (Andi Viola) works as a pickpocket without her mother’s knowledge. The same goes for Emir (Emyr Razan), who—unbeknownst to his family—is both eager and forced into the role because he can’t find a job, and eventually decides to pursue a career as a pickpocket. The story goes that one day, Emir and Dinda actually got into a fight over a stolen wallet. Dinda almost fell, but Emir quickly came to her rescue. As a result, their eyes met.
